works.heroHeading: A little of what I've been building.
works.heroBody: Throughout my career, I've had the chance to work on different projects, each with its own challenges and lessons. Here are some of them.
works.contactBody: You bring the challenge. We explore the possible paths and find a solution that makes sense for what you want to build.

home.heroHeading: From problem to solution. Making complex challenges simple.
home.heroBody: A product may have countless features and possibilities, but for those on the other side, the experience needs to be clear and intuitive. Finding a simple way to solve a complex problem is just as important as the implementation of the solution itself.
home.qualityHeading: Obsession with quality in every detail.
home.qualityBody: A solution should not be evaluated only by whether it works or how it looks. Quality is also in the user experience, in performance, and in how its elements behave and relate to each other. More than producing something functional, it is essential to know what to build, why to build it, and how to make it meaningful for the product and for those who will use it.
home.projectsHeading: When the product stops being just another one.
home.projectsBody: An identity is not just about a product's appearance, but about its ability to have its own characteristics, be recognizable, and make sense within what is being built. It is what makes a product stop being just another visually appealing solution and begin to have a presence of its own.
home.criteriaHeading: Not everything that can be done needs to be done.
home.criteriaBody: The easier it becomes to produce, the greater the number of possibilities. And, in the face of them, knowing how to choose becomes as valuable as knowing how to build.
home.contactBody: You bring the challenge. We explore the possibilities. And, together, we find a solution that makes sense.
